C1449.title: SUUM Attack: Timestamp-Based Vulnerabilities in Nakamoto-Style Blockchains
C1449.summary: This study introduces the SUUM (Staircase-Unrestricted Uncle Maker) attack, the first block-withholding attack targeting timestamp-based Nakamoto-style blockchains.
